title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.2.0-preview.4
summary: Adds a manual updater for this fork and identifies El3ctro99 as its current maintainer in About, retaining upstream and original contributor credits.
changes: About displays the full preview version and current fork maintainer, with links to this fork's GitHub releases.
Check for updates selects newer eligible releases from El3ctro99/MouseWithoutBorders-Portable; checks and installation remain user-initiated.
Downloads validate asset URLs, sizes, SHA-256, architecture and embedded version before a parent-bound helper replaces only the normal EXE.
Safe shutdown preserves preferences and transfer recovery; failed initial startup triggers an old-EXE restore/restart attempt.
Private user-profile staging, cancellation, bounded timeouts and cleanup avoid changing the optional protected-UAC service.
testing: Release x64 build, 102 focused updater/About checks and 65 existing UAC/connection/settings regression checks passed locally on Windows.
Actual GitHub preview 3 assets passed download, CDN redirect, size, SHA-256, architecture and product-version checks without executing the downloaded payload.
Use the same normal-app version on each PC. Earlier builds require one manual EXE replacement to acquire the new updater; retain adjacent preferences and recovery files.
See docs/UPDATER_VALIDATION.md for exact automated, process-fixture and physical-PC evidence limits.
known_limitations: Unsigned Windows x64 preview. The three-second process startup check does not establish a working peer connection or detect later failures.
In-app replacement requires a local user-profile path with safe ownership/permissions throughout its ancestry. Other locations require a manual EXE replacement.
The optional preview 3 protected-UAC service remains compatible and is not updated by the in-app updater; use its separate package for service changes.
No new physical two-PC, lock/sign-in or sleep/wake acceptance is claimed. Existing inherited full-suite failures are documented separately.
